summary: Axogen, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a September 9, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire BioCircuit Technologies, Inc. via merger sub for a $200.0 million cash base purchase price, subject to customary cash, debt, transaction expense and net working capital adjustments, with $1.0 million withheld at closing for post-closing adjustments. BioCircuit's NerveTape and ConformaWrap peripheral-nerve repair assets are the target; an unrelated electronics business will be spun out pre-closing. Axogen intends to fund via a concurrent public common stock offering, must secure financing within 90 days, and expects a Q4 2026 close with no regulatory approvals required. Watch financing/offering execution risk and closing conditions.
